en.title: Commercial proposal or SOW
en.summary: Turns discovery notes into a client-ready commercial proposal or SOW with scope, deliverables, timeline, three pricing options and terms.
useWhen: You just finished a discovery call and need the proposal
There is a verbal agreement and it is time to write the SOW
You want to show the client three pricing options
notFor: Replacing a lawyer's review of the terms
Setting prices without your input: it inserts [PRICE] placeholders
en.output: A Markdown document, proposal_[client]_[date].md (or sow_...), with deliverables, timeline and pricing option tables.

faq.q: Does it invent prices or client facts?
faq.a: No. Without pricing input it inserts [PRICE] placeholders with the rationale for each figure, and every claim must trace back to what you provided.

faq.q: When does it write a proposal versus a SOW?
faq.a: By default a proposal for early deals and a SOW when you mention a verbal agreement or a signed proposal. It confirms the choice before drafting.

faq.q: Can I use the legal terms as they are?
faq.a: No. The terms are marked subject to legal review and are not legal advice.
